title: 高盛闪辉：4.4%够不够，**下滑何时见底？
speaker: Hui Shan

segments.en: What should we be really looking at for the numbers that we're getting Monday? It's a big data dump. It's the monthly data dumps where you get the retail sales they've been weak, no doubt. You're going to get industrial production, fixed asset urban investment, and you're also going to get the quarterly GDP number expected to be around 4.4%. Is that good enough?
segments.zh: 周一的数据我们到底该看什么？这是一大波数据。月度数据里，零售销售一直偏弱，这毫无疑问。还会看到工业增加值、城镇固定资产投资，以及季度GDP，预期在4.4%左右。这够好吗？

segments.en: That might be good enough for the full-year growth target. You just need a four and a half, right? The first half of year, 4.7. So second half you get 4.4, then you finish the year within your target.
segments.zh: 对全年增长目标来说可能够了。你只需要4.5左右，对吧？上半年4.7，下半年4.4，全年就能落在目标区间内。

segments.en: I think the other two important variables to watch is fixed asset investment first, because we saw the investment, at least the fixed asset investment, the series have been plunging. So whether we're seeing any signs of stabilization, whether whether it's improving or whether the government is helping supporting investment, we're just going to look at the slope of a decline. Is that moderating or is still accelerating?
segments.zh: 另外两个重要变量，第一是固定资产投资，因为这一系列数据一直在快速下滑。我们要看是否有企稳迹象，是在改善，还是政府在支持投资，就看下滑斜率是在放缓还是在加速。

segments.en: The survey says it's going to continue to contract by another 7.3% after 7.2% the previous month. Yeah, so we are, I think, we're slightly above consensus. So we'll see. That's one variable that will be pay attention to the other, I think, as the retail sales, how weak it is, and get a sense of a consumption momentum.
segments.zh: 调查显示，在上月7.2%之后还会再收缩7.3%。是的，我们认为我们略高于市场一致预期。所以再看吧。这是一个要关注的变量，另一个是零售销售到底有多弱，以判断消费动能。

segments.en: I mean, we've been here in this weak retail, private household consumption story for years now. How much of it is, because we're just used to, we were used to high growth rates, how much of it is math, high base, and how much of it is down to something else, and what is that something else? Now that we're a few years into, what's the prognosis? Yeah.
segments.zh: 这种零售和居民消费偏弱的故事已经持续好几年了。有多少是因为我们习惯了高增速，有多少是基数效应，又有多少是其他原因，那个其他原因是什么？现在已经几年了，前景如何？是的。

segments.en: I think when it comes to household consumption, it's both, right, we're so used to that, you know, that food, booming years, and consumption can be growing in close to 10% per year, whereas now it's, you know, barely positive, but at the same time, the basic fact, the trading program, you know, the EV tax, purchase tax increase, all of these technical factors are also behind the weakness.
segments.zh: 谈到居民消费，两方面都有。我们太习惯繁荣年代，消费每年能增长近10%，而现在几乎只是微正。但同时，基本事实是，以旧换新计划、电动车税收、购置税上调等技术性因素也在拖累。

segments.en: One more thing on the retail sales, retail sales are not necessarily just household. We are seeing now the local governments are under significant amount of a pressure, so government purchases of retail items, goods, and services, that will also drive weakness in that series.
segments.zh: 关于零售销售还有一点，它不一定只反映居民。现在地方政府面临较大压力，政府对零售商品和服务的采购也会拖累这一数据。
